summary.text: Dawn Richardson is the Democratic candidate for Texas House District 54 in the November 3, 2026 general election, challenging incumbent Republican Brad Buckley.
She is a retired teacher and school administrator.

paragraphs.text: Richardson was born in New York City and earned a bachelor's degree from LeMoyne College in 1981 and a graduate degree from the University of Phoenix in 2010.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a retired educator with 39 years of service, the last 27 in Killeen, who taught science and math and coached basketball and cheerleading.
She said she has served as president of the Exchange Club of Killeen and is a past president of the Killeen Education Association.
Richardson's listed affiliations include TSTA-Retired, AARP, the Exchange Club of Killeen and Greater Peace Missionary Baptist Church.
Her 2024 survey messages included opposing school voucher plans, fully funding public schools, supporting reproductive rights, making health care affordable and supporting veterans' health care.
